name: Laws of Belize (Revised Edition 2020, Acts 2021-2026 and statutory instruments 2020-2026)
label: Belize
record_note: The Chapters of the Substantive Laws of Belize and the instruments of the Subsidiary Laws, Revised Edition 2020, as at 31 December 2020 (one version each, current-only: agm.gov.bz publishes no earlier consolidation); the Acts of 2021 to 2026 as enacted, dated by assent; and the statutory instruments of 2020 to 2026 that have a text layer, as made, dated by their Gazette date. Later Acts and instruments are not applied to the texts they amend; scanned instruments with no text layer are listed, not built.

dates.commit: Chapters: the Revised Edition 2020 as-at date (2020-12-31). Acts: the day of assent, the day an Act comes into force unless it sets another (Interpretation Act, Cap. 1, s. 41); the gazetted day where no assent date is printed. Subsidiary laws: the Revised Edition 2020 as-at date. Statutory instruments: the day gazetted, when an instrument has the force of law unless it names another day (Cap. 1, s. 21(h)); the made day where no Gazette date is readable

author.enacted: the Act or instrument itself (act-<year>-<number>@agm-gov-bz.invalid, si-<year>-<number>@agm-gov-bz.invalid)
author.amendment: none: no amendment is applied to a Chapter

scope.when_absent: not extracted for Belize; commencement, savings and transitional rules are in each Act

default_reach.rule: presumption against retroactivity, and savings on repeal
default_reach.meaning: unless the contrary intention appears, a repeal does not revive anything not in force, or affect the previous operation of the repealed law, rights and liabilities accrued under it, penalties incurred, or proceedings about them
default_reach.authority: Interpretation Act, Chapter 1 of the Substantive Laws of Belize, R.E. 2020, s. 28 (other effects of repeal); s. 41 (an Act comes into force on assent unless it says otherwise)

reuse: none found: the Copyright Act, Cap. 252, excludes no legislation and gives the State copyright in works made by or under the direction or control of the Government (s. 25(4)); private repository
